d:
A raw and electrifying track, " Mudda Kya Hai?" is the ultimate moshpit anthem delivered by two of the sharpest pens of the season. The song is a relentless showcase of back-to-back bars, razor-sharp punchlines, and seamless flow switches, making it a lyrical powerhouse
Song Credits
Track Name: Mudda Kya Hai
Written & Performed By: Naam Sujal - Vichaar
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: Naam Sujal - Vichaar
Track Name: Mudda Kya Hai
Singer/Performed By/Cast: Naam Sujal - Vichaar
